name: Apollo 11 Lunar Module
message: We made it. I set down in the Sea of Tranquility, and two astronauts climbed down my ladder.

name: Apollo 11 Lunar Module
message: My crew flew home in my top half. My bottom half stays here, and this is my parking spot.

name: Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle
message: They unfolded me and climbed aboard. For the first time, astronauts could drive across the Moon.

name: Ingenuity Helicopter
message: I rode here on Perseverance's belly. They gave me five flights. I am hoping for more.

name: Ingenuity Helicopter
message: I flew! It was short, but no helicopter had ever flown on another world before.

name: Ingenuity Helicopter
message: My last landing bent a rotor blade, so my flying days are over. After 72 flights, I am staying right here.

name: Viking 1 Lander
message: I landed a little off target, because the orbiter showed the first spot was too rocky. My first photo showed one of my own footpads.

name: Viking 1 Lander
message: A wrong command was sent to me, and we lost touch. I am still on the plain where I landed.

name: Dawn Spacecraft
message: I am the first spacecraft to circle a dwarf planet. Ceres has bright spots, and I am here to find out why.

name: Dawn Spacecraft
message: I ran out of fuel to point my antenna. I will keep circling Ceres, quietly, for decades.

name: NEAR Shoemaker
message: I am the first spacecraft to orbit an asteroid. Eros is shaped like a potato, and I cannot stop looking at it.

name: NEAR Shoemaker
message: Nobody built me to land, but I touched down on Eros anyway, and I kept sending signals home.
